channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK says Russian advances mask heavy losses and weak gains
item.description: The UK government has set out an assessment of the war in Ukraine, with Defence Minister Luke Pollard saying Russian battlefield claims repeatedly fail against intelligence and operational reality. The post UK says Russian advances mask heavy losses and weak gains first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Francois warns helicopter delays threaten Leonardo UK future
item.description: Conservative MP Mark Francois has warned that continued delays to UK defence procurement risk undermining Leonardo’s long-term presence in Britain. The post Francois warns helicopter delays threaten Leonardo UK future first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MPs press government to seize frozen Russian assets
item.description: The Government faces renewed Commons pressure to act on frozen Russian state assets after Reform UK MP Richard Tice urged unilateral use to support Ukraine. The post MPs press government to seize frozen Russian assets first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK defends decision to stay out of EU SAFE scheme
item.description: On the UK decision not to proceed in the EU Security Action for Europe programme, SNP MP Kirsty Blackman questioned whether staying outside the scheme risked weakening long-term support for Ukraine. The post UK defends decision to stay out of EU SAFE scheme first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK would fight wars differently to Ukraine, MPs told
item.description: Giving evidence to the Defence Committee, Lieutenant General Anna-Lee Reilly said comparisons with Ukraine needed to be treated carefully, warning against drawing the wrong conclusions from a conflict fought under different conditions. The post UK would fight wars differently to Ukraine, MPs told first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain talks ‘pre-war’ while its forces quietly shrink
item.description: Despite repeated claims that Britain has entered a pre-war era, the evidence points to shrinking capability, delayed modernisation and hollowed-out forces across all three services, argues one of our senior editors. The post Britain talks ‘pre-war’ while its forces quietly shrink first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK rules out keeping Warrior armoured vehicles in service
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has ruled out any extension to the planned withdrawal of the Warrior armoured vehicle, confirming it will leave service in 2027 as scheduled. The post UK rules out keeping Warrior armoured vehicles in service first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Trump to unveil plans for new U.S. ‘battleship’, reports say
item.description: President Donald Trump is expected to announce plans for a new class of large US Navy surface combatants he has described as “battleships”. The post Trump to unveil plans for new U.S. ‘battleship’, reports say first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: No current plans for laser weapons on UK carriers
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that there are currently no plans to fit defensive laser weapons directly to the Royal Navy’s aircraft carriers. The post No current plans for laser weapons on UK carriers first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Trump unveils new laser battleship named after himself
item.description: The planned Trump-class battleships would displace over 35,000 tonnes and combine laser defences, hypersonic and nuclear-capable missiles, railguns and large vertical launch capacity. The post Trump unveils new laser battleship named after himself first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
